Config.title: Portal Configuration
Config.description: System wide configuration specifying the target iframe URL and access passcodes.

iframeUrl.description: The URL of the embedded page.

overlayEnabled.description: True if floating overlay is active during screen share.

overlayText.description: Optional text to float over screen share.

overlayImageUrl.description: Optional image URL to float over screen share.

overlayPosition.description: Placement of the overlay: e.g. top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, center, or floating-animate.

overlayScale.description: Scale of the overlay in percent (50 to 200).

isLive.description: True if the live broadcast is running.

liveStreamType.description: The type of the live stream.

streamStartedAt.description: Unix timestamp of when the session started.

ActiveVisitor.title: Active Visitor
ActiveVisitor.description: Track live viewer count and session presence metadata in real-time.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: Messages sent during the live screen sharing session.

SignalingPeer.title: Signaling Peer
SignalingPeer.description: WebRTC signaling state documents for direct stream peers.

RegisteredUser.title: Registered User
RegisteredUser.description: User account for gate authorization using username and password.

configs/{configId}.description: A collection containing system configuration documents.

active_visitors/{visitorId}.description: Temporary documents tracking presence of visitors and admins currently connected.

chats/{chatId}.description: A collection of messages posted to the real-time stream chat overlay.

signaling_peers/{peerId}.description: WebRTC peer connection endpoints for sub-second screencast routing.
